//| label: fig-tour-mode

digraph TourModeChoice {
    rankdir=LR
    node [shape=box, style=filled, fillcolor=white]

    Choice [fillcolor=white]
// Auto subgroup (blue)
    Auto      [fillcolor="#cfe2f3"]
    DA        [label="Drive Alone",      fillcolor="#cfe2f3"]

    SR3       [label="Shared Ride 3+",   fillcolor="#cfe2f3"]
    DA_Free   [label="Drive Alone Free", fillcolor="#cfe2f3"]
    DA_Pay    [label="Drive Alone Pay",  fillcolor="#cfe2f3"]

    SR2_Pay   [label="Shared Ride 2 Pay",  fillcolor="#cfe2f3"]
    SR3_Free  [label="Shared Ride 3 Free", fillcolor="#cfe2f3"]
    SR3_Pay   [label="Shared Ride 3 Pay",  fillcolor="#cfe2f3"]

    // Non-Motorized subgroup (green)
    NonMotorized [label="Non-Motorized", fillcolor="#d9ead3"]
    Walk         [fillcolor="#d9ead3"]
    Bike         [fillcolor="#d9ead3"]

    // Transit subgroup (orange)
    Transit      [fillcolor="#fce5cd"]
    WalkTransit  [label="Walk-Transit",   fillcolor="#fce5cd"]
    WalkLocal    [label="Walk-Local",      fillcolor="#fce5cd"]
    WalkLRT      [label="Walk-LRT&Ferry",  fillcolor="#fce5cd"]
    WalkExpress  [label="Walk-Express",    fillcolor="#fce5cd"]
    WalkHeavy    [label="Walk-Heavy Rail", fillcolor="#fce5cd"]
    WalkComm     [label="Walk-Comm Rail",  fillcolor="#fce5cd"]
    DriveTransit [label="Drive-Transit",   fillcolor="#fce5cd"]
    DriveLocal   [label="Drive-Local",     fillcolor="#fce5cd"]
    DriveLRT     [label="Drive-LRT&Ferry", fillcolor="#fce5cd"]
    DriveExpress [label="Drive-Express",   fillcolor="#fce5cd"]
    DriveHeavy   [label="Drive-Heavy Rail",fillcolor="#fce5cd"]
    DriveComm    [label="Drive-Comm Rail", fillcolor="#fce5cd"]

    // Ride-Hail subgroup (purple)
    RideHail  [label="Ride-Hail", fillcolor="#d9d2e9"]
    Taxi      [fillcolor="#d9d2e9"]
    TNC       [label="TNC",        fillcolor="#d9d2e9"]
    TNCShared [label="TNC Shared", fillcolor="#d9d2e9"]

    Choice -> Auto
    Choice -> NonMotorized

    Choice -> RideHail
    Auto->DA

    NonMotorized->Walk

}
